notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg[/img]

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: 4/21/2015 Update
notes.notes:
The new update for REVOLVER360 RE:ACTOR contains the following fixes: 
- Fixed screen resolution issue 
- Added Offline mode option(in Config_EN.exe)
- The mouse cursor is now hidden in full screen

アップデート内容：
- 保存した解像度が反映されない不具合を修正
- オフラインモードオプションを追加（Configツール）
- フルスクリーン時にマウスカーソルを非表示にするよう変更

notes.title: Control Update + Original Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Revolver 360 RE:ACTOR has been updated.

Patch Notes:

- WASD controls for keyboard input, as well as customizable keyboard layout added
- 1366 x 768 resolution support added
- Full controller support added (Xbox 360 Controller Recommended)
- Keyboard controls updated
- Original soundtrack now included upon initial purchase
